text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 108,170.35 in Period 5 to 90,600.15 in Period 10 while I made no trades; I should monitor risk and have a plan for downturns rather than assume doing nothing is always best.","I bought several stocks within two periods, then held them through a prolonged decline; I should limit concentration and consider whether my portfolio remains appropriate as prices change.","Short-term gains and losses do not reveal whether my approach is working, so I should compare results with a suitable benchmark and keep decisions aligned with my ten-year apartment goal."]}
